When someone dies
The practical checklist.

The things that have to happen, in roughly the order they need to happen. Our AI planner walks you through each one.

Notify immediate family — before social media, before anyone else
Contact a funeral home — even if you're not sure what you want yet
Secure the death certificate — you will need multiple copies
Write or share the obituary — we can help with this
Notify employer, bank, Social Security
Plan the service or celebration of life
Handle the estate and belongings — in your own time
Close or memorialize social media accounts
Send thank you notes — when you're ready, not before
How it works
A plan in four steps.

Our AI planner asks gentle questions and builds a personalized, step-by-step plan for your situation.

1
Tell us what happened

A death, a diagnosis, a divorce — whatever you're facing. No wrong answers.

2
Answer a few questions

Timeline, budget, who's involved, how much help you need. Only what matters.

3
Get your plan

A personalized checklist, timeline, and vendor guide — built for your situation.

4
We stay with you

Check things off. Come back when the next task feels impossible. We'll be here.
